verdict.rationale: The interactive CLI lets you type natural-language tasks with instant feedback and pause a running agent with Esc. Conversations can be resumed, and goal-based sessions expose stop/resume controls. Together these imply you can interject new instructions into the same session, but no item explicitly documents sending a steering message mid-run without restarting. The ask-agent feature only handles side questions that don't change the main flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of injecting follow-up or steering messages into a running conversation (CLI, GUI or Agent Server WebSocket), and hands-on or independent corroboration that steering works mid-task.
